coordinate_convention: Saved source/target coordinates use original-resolution pixel centers; x right, y down. Seeds use 1008x1344 preview pixel centers. Convert by (p+.5)*original_size/preview_size-.5.
provenance: Assistant visually selected architectural locations and target neighborhoods. Local scaled NCC refines target positions. IDs 13-16 are excluded from fitting; visually revised annotations are not blind validation.
